verdict.rationale: Deployment environments with approval gates are a fair axis for a Git forge with built-in CI/CD, so the story applies. The evidence only shows generic Gitea Actions CI/CD (GitHub Actions-compatible YAML workflows) and integrations with external tools such as Argo CD and Jenkins. Nothing documents first-party environments, deployment approval gates, or tracking which change is deployed where. Generic CI and third-party integrations are adjacent features or external tools, so they earn no credit.
